setup_contract.catalog: Complete DramaInput records per case; replaces base_records. source/source_id/language are identity; aliases resolve to generated IDs, recorded in manifest.
setup_contract.facts: Evidence-sidecar item facts keyed by source_id; never fabricate candidate result fields.
setup_contract.rank_history: Exact mirror daily/weekly source periods; setup failure if materializer cannot represent.
setup_contract.prior_results: Seed explicit synthetic historical owner/thread/result/run rows using existing fixture APIs/ORM. Label origin=synthetic_fixture in materialization ledger. These rows are preconditions, never observed acceptance-run success. Generate no additional Agent runs; actual acceptance attempts retain genuine outcomes. Aliases map to recorded actual IDs.
setup_contract.faults: Harness boundary schedule, no extra model runs; unimplemented schedule is explicit setup failure.
setup_contract.ui_commands: Actual authenticated requests with fixed idempotency key; no model write authority.
setup_contract.unsupported: Do not guess/skip silently; record unsupported setup and obtain parent resolution before runs.
